messages:
Jules: Heads-up — EchoPoint POC is seeing billing weirdness + 429s. Customer reports free credits dropped below zero (-$0.02) and then started getting 429s after ~10k tokens. Can we triage? @Priya :eyes:
Priya: Yikes. Which account ID / project? Any customer screenshots or request IDs?
Jules: Account ID: echopoint-prod-43. Screenshot attached in thread (they redacted emails). Says they ran a batch of evals overnight. console link: https://console.redwood.ai/poc/echopoint-prod-43
Evan: Could be double-counting on retry + a batching edge. Ask for a representative request_id from when they saw the 429 and a sample curl. Also confirm whether they used streaming or non-streaming.
Jules: Sent ask to customer for request_id and curl. They sent this snippet when it started failing:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxxx"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4r-xl","input":"<eval payload>","max_tokens":1024}'
```
Jules: Their logs show a 429 with header `x-rwd-req: rwd-req-20260315-9a7c`.
Nadia: Can you paste the raw response headers and the retry-after? If there's a retry storm the billing meter could be counting more than expected due to immediate retries. Also: did they enable client-side retries?
Jules: They said they used our JS SDK default retry (3 attempts). They also said they kicked off 30 parallel evals. So maybe retries * parallelism.
Evan: Ok — two hypotheses: 1) concurrent evals + client retries => apparent token spike; 2) an internal race where the token accounting metric emitted duplicate events for batched requests. I'll pull server logs for that request id. @deploy-bot can you fetch logs for rwd-req-20260315-9a7c across prod-ingest?
deploy-bot: Fetching logs for rwd-req-20260315-9a7c from prod-ingest... (this may take ~30s)
deploy-bot: Logs found: 2000+ lines, pruning to relevant frames.
Nadia: Paste the snippet around the timestamp id. Also check for duplicate intake events or idempotency token mismatch.
Evan: Found this from ingest:
```
[2026-03-15T03:14:22Z] rwd-req-20260315-9a7c received batch(seq=42) payload tokens=10240
[2026-03-15T03:14:22Z] rwd-req-20260315-9a7c forwarded to runtime node-7 (trace=tx-77)
[2026-03-15T03:14:23Z] tx-77 ack received from node-7 tokens_consumed=10240
[2026-03-15T03:14:23Z] rwd-req-20260315-9a7c retry attempted (client retry 1)
[2026-03-15T03:14:23Z] rwd-req-20260315-9a7c forwarded to runtime node-3 (trace=tx-78)
[2026-03-15T03:14:23Z] tx-78 ack received tokens_consumed=10240
```
Evan: Looks like duplicate consumption events — same request id got processed twice due to client retry arriving before ack dedup completed. That would double-count token usage.
Nadia: That explains the negative-ish free credits if accounting expected a refund path but we double-billed then later issued a partial credit. We'll need to: 1) confirm dedupe window and ensure ingest uses idempotency key checks before accounting; 2) issue invoice credit and fix telemetry. I'll open a ticket for ops/ingest.
Priya: Customer will want a clear timeline + credits applied. Can we do quick math for what to credit? They ran 30 parallel evals x 3 retries x 10k tokens ~= 900k tokens. At their trial rate that explains the jump.
Evan: I'll compute precisely after we confirm how many of those retries actually reached accounting. Nadia — can ops export the accounting events for echopoint-prod-43 between 2026-03-15T03:00 and 03:30?
Nadia: On it. Also flagging this to billing-bot to prepare provisional credit.
billing-bot: Noted. Provisional credit hold placed for account echopoint-prod-43: $0.00 -> pending review. Use /billing adjust once confirmed.
Jules: Customer also has enterprise SSO/Security questionnaire open. They're worried about the same bug being exploited for cost attacks. Can we loop in Solutions to provide mitigations (rate limits per API key, per project)?
Priya: I'll cc Solutions and send the SSO/Sec questionnaire answers. For immediate mitigation suggest reduced client-side retries + server-side idempotency enforcement and per-key rate caps.
Evan: Quick patch: increase dedupe TTL and gate accounting until ingest ack is finalized. That reduces double-bill risk. We'll schedule hotfix for the ingest path.
Nadia: Filing ops ticket now: OPS-3921 "Ingest dedupe + accounting race causing double-count". Assigning to ingest team. ETA for hotfix: 4 hours (triage -> patch -> canary).
Jules: I'll tell the customer we found the likely cause, provisional credit pending, and ETA for fix ~4h. Also prepping a short postmortem for their security team.
Priya: Thanks all. @Jules ping me once credit applied and I'll update quote/renewal talk. :thumbsup:
